tool.name: scCellFie preprocessing
tool.description: normalize, correct gene names, or subsample an AnnData object

param.name: method
param.label: Preprocessing method
param.option: Transform Ensembl gene IDs to gene symbols

param.name: target_sum
param.label: Target sum for CP-normalization
param.help: Each cell will have a total count equal to this value after normalization

param.name: n_counts_key
param.label: Column in adata.obs with total counts per cell

param.name: chunk_size
param.label: Number of cells to process at a time
param.help: Leave empty to process the entire matrix at once. Recommended for very large datasets (more than 1 million cells)

param.name: drop_unmapped
param.label: Drop genes that could not be mapped to a symbol?

param.name: group_column
param.label: Column in adata.obs to stratify by
param.help: e.g. cell type or cluster annotation

param.name: target_fraction
param.label: Fraction of cells to sample from each group

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Provides common preprocessing utilities used before running the scCellFie pipeline:
- **Normalize counts per cell**: memory-efficient CP-normalization (counts per X, e.g. CP10K) that works directly on sparse matrices. - **Transform Ensembl gene IDs to gene symbols**: maps ``adata.var_names`` from Ensembl IDs to gene symbols for human or mouse, required by the scCellFie metabolic task database. - **Stratified subsampling**: samples a fraction of cells from each group (e.g. cell type), useful to reduce the size of very large datasets while preserving group proportions.
**Input**
- An AnnData object (``.h5ad``).
**Output**
- The processed AnnData object (``.h5ad``).
